name: effect-only-profiles
goal: Measure actual effect-only module initialization without treating deferred callables or failed imports as successful runtime work

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The native quiet module mutates logger startup state but has no variable declaration. Source profiling currently emits no timing or memory for that executed initialization.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing initializedModules matrix covers literal data, deferred callables and failed initialization, but not effect-only modules. Add successful and throwing effect-only inputs to that same normal corpus.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 7283db85a, the strengthened initializedModules matrix reproduces zero observations for an executed effect-only module. Existing data and deferred-callable controls remain unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The source adapter measures completed effect-only initialization with no callable body; throws never reach the finishing sample, and deferred-callable exclusions remain intact.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged initializedModules corpus sealed c23970a9 red and df1d6881 green at a7100cde4. Both success and throwing effect inputs pass the 15-case runner matrix; lifecycle matrix also passes.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
